project.description: Phase 2 exit criteria, enforced in code: one fixture CanonicalEvent is run through every registered RecommendationProvider's mapper, asserting no required field is silently dropped. This is what catches schema drift between @omnirec/core's OutgoingEvent and any provider's mapping logic before it ships. No live provider credentials are used — only the pure mapper methods (toPersonalizeEvent, toUserEvent) are exercised.
